title: 1. Enthusiastic
slide_intent: Define the limits of sensory enthusiasm so writers can express personality without creating the wrong impression.
strategic_value: Descriptive food phrases can make Burger King sound excited about taste without sounding uncontrolled.
demonstration: Energetic, excited and spirited language is bounded by cautions against manic, naive and childish expression. The right column compares sensory phrases with repetitive shouting, bland claims and forced rhymes.
practical_value: Use vivid taste, appearance and texture words, then test whether the line becomes exaggerated or childish.
